name: SEA-LION (AI Singapore)
description: AI Singapore's own Southeast Asian language models behind a free API.
overview: SEA-LION is AI Singapore's open model family for Southeast Asian languages, served first-party through an OpenAI-compatible API. The free trial key is explicitly meant for prototyping and testing, capped at 10 calls per minute per account, with no published token budget or expiry; production use is directed to AI Singapore's cloud partners. Keys come from the playground key manager after signup, and the model list needs a key to read.
notes: Prototyping only per AI Singapore's terms; no published token budget.
